summary: refactor(handlers-drive): address shotgun surgery on info variable

delivery.outcome: Shotgun surgery on 'info' is removed: all drive ACK info payloads are sent through _send_info_ack and optional result keys are copied via _result_fields; 'info' is constructed once, never mutated.
nonGoals: Changing ACK message content, ordering or audit semantics
Refactoring unrelated drive routing or calibration logic

architecture.decision: Introduce _send_info_ack(daemon, client, corr, info, ok=) and _result_fields(result, keys, truthy=); replace info-mutation loops with dict construction.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch; pure function-level refactor in one module.

validation.evidence: Daemon drive handler tests pass; ack payloads unchanged.
